etymology: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of 4474, through the idea of sudden motion)
avSummary: cast down 2, cast 2, scatter abroad 1, cast out 1, throw 1
definition:
1) to cast, throw
 2) throw down
 3) to cast forward or before
 4) to set down (with the suggestion of haste and want of care)
 5) to throw to the ground, prostrate
